claims.author: w0xlt
claims.question: Can wallet rebroadcasting safely be disabled, and if so, why is rebroadcasting needed at all?
claims.quote: Can we safely disable wallet re-broadcasting? If so, why do we need re-broadcasting at all?

status_by.quote: I think yes. Most users don't need it, but are nevertheless exposed to the privacy leaks it brings even if they never us

claims.status_note: author explains why rebroadcasting is useful and why disabling it can be safe

claims.author: w0xlt
claims.quote: extending `-walletbroadcast` with new modes would be cleaner than introducing another parameter with a very similar name.
claims.request: Extend -walletbroadcast with new modes instead of introducing another parameter with a very similar name

status_by.quote: don't introduce a new option, instead extend the allowed values of `-walletbroadcast`.

claims.status_note: author pushed a change extending -walletbroadcast instead of introducing a new option

claims.author: vicjuma
claims.harm: Defaulting -walletrebroadcast to false harms convenience for users who expect rebroadcasts without extra setup
claims.quote: IMO, I think rebroadcasting outweighs privacy so defaulting to true would be convenient.

status_by.quote: Now the default behavior is unmodified.

claims.status_note: author pushed a change keeping default behavior unmodified

claims.author: mzumsande
claims.quote: if we disable rebroadcast, we should probably also disable artificial resubmission to mempool
claims.request: Disable artificial resubmission to mempool as well if rebroadcast is disabled
